title: Convert Shapes to Table (Tables)

scenarios.title: Convert Shapes to Table applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Convert Shapes to Table (BtnConvertToTable) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: BtnConvertToTable deterministic Office leg

requirements.text: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, with a fixture grid of nine 100x50 pt text rectangles (r1c1..r3c3) tiled at 40/40 with a total of 300x150 pt and selected as one shape range, the non-interactive conversion (ReplaceOriginals, no prompts) deletes the nine rectangles and produces exactly one 3x3 table carrying the fixture texts at 40/40 with 100 pt columns and 50 pt rows, reports execution, writes no new error-log entry, and tears down cleanly.

scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, with a fixture grid of nine 100x50 pt text rectangles (r1c1..r3c3) tiled at 40/40 with a total of 300x150 pt and selected as one shape range, the non-interactive conversion (ReplaceOriginals, no prompts) deletes the nine rectangles and produces exactly one 3x3 table carrying the fixture texts at 40/40 with 100 pt columns and 50 pt rows, reports execution, writes no new error-log entry, and tears down cleanly.

done.statement: The deterministic Office leg passes against the configured build on an isolated PowerPoint host with zero new error-log entries and full teardown; bind-office-evidence-and-reviews remains until this office scenario has real-host evidence and review.
